name: r-replication-package
description: Prepare readable, independently runnable research replication packages with explicit R models, modelsummary tables, and result verification.

interface.shortDescription: 按文章结构整理复现数据与简明R代码，导表并核验独立运行
interface.longDescription: Organize replication data and explicit R code by manuscript sections, export tables from fitted models, compare results with the manuscript, and verify execution from a clean directory.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $r-replication-package，按我指定的论文、分析范围和目录结构整理可独立运行的复现数据与代码。
